text: Assumption: StringView::contains provides thread-safety and reentrancy — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: StringView::contains provides thread-safety and reentrancy — is this correct?
norm: stringview contains provides thread safety and reentrancy
rationale: The AUTOSAR specification makes no explicit statement regarding the thread-safety of StringView::contains; however, from the declaration as const and noexcept as well as the alignment with C++23 [string.view], reentrancy for concurrent read accesses usually follows.

original.text: Annahme: Thread-Sicherheit und Reentranz — trifft das zu?
